title: Performance Insights: Unified per-model & per-route dashboard UX and chart specs
creator: Claire Reed
description: Design ticket to define the UX, interaction patterns, and chart-level specs for a combined per-model and per-route performance insights page in Redwood Console. Purpose: give engineers, SREs, and PMs a single surface to understand latency, throughput, token usage, and cost signals for a model version and every route that uses it. Deliverables include high-fidelity prototypes (overview + route-detail), a set of canonical chart specs (aggregations, percentiles, default time windows), and interaction notes for comparison, rollouts, and alerting triggers.
background: Current console views are fragmented: model catalog has basic perf numbers, routes have separate logs, and cost breakdowns live in a different tab. Customers increasingly ask for a single, explorable view to diagnose regressions during model rollouts and to correlate token distributions with latency and cost. This work synthesizes design research, recent SLO incidents, and backend availability of 1-minute aggregated metrics and raw samples for tail analysis.
prototypes: Figma: Overview dashboard with model selector + route list
Figma: Route detail with token histogram and tail latency waterfall
Clickable: comparison mode (version A vs B)
acceptance_criteria: Overview shows model-level 50/90/99 latency, throughput (req/s), avg tokens per request, and cost per 1k tokens for last 24h by default
Route list shows top 10 routes by QPS with sparkline and quick filter by traffic tier
Route detail includes latency percentile chart (p50/p90/p99), token distribution histogram, throughput heatmap, and cost breakdown by tokens vs model variant
Charts support comparison mode across two model versions or time ranges and persist selected time window across charts
Exportable CSV for the selected time window and route; links to relevant runbooks and recent deployments
chart_specs: Latency Percentiles (line band): metric=latency_ms; aggregation=percentiles 50,90,99; time_window=auto (default 24h) with selectable presets 1h/6h/24h/7d; sampling=1m aggregate; y_axis=log scale toggle; annotation=deployments & canary start/end; tooltip=show count and mean at hover

Throughput (bar+line): metric=requests_per_min and tokens_per_min; visualization=stacked bars (routes) + overlay line for sustained QPS; time_window=same as user selection; downsampling=sum per 1m; color=route palette consistent with route list

Token Distribution (histogram): metric=tokens_per_request; bins=auto (default 20) with option to set buckets; aggregation=percentile ranges highlighted; show mean, median, and right-tail percent of requests with tokens>threshold; use jittered raw-sample points for low-traffic routes

Tail Latency Waterfall: metric=latency_ms sample view; source=raw samples for last 1h/6h; sort by latency; show request metadata peek (route, model version, token count); interaction=open trace/trace-id button when available
Throughput Heatmap (time-of-day vs minute): metric=reqs; buckets=5m x hourly grid; colorScale=quantile to surface hotspots; supports timezone selection and filtering by route/model
Cost per 1k tokens (area): metric=cost_usd_per_1000_tokens computed from rate card + token usage; show trend and breakdown by model variant; overlay with throughput to show cost efficiency

Correlation Scatter (tokens vs latency): metric_pair=(tokens_per_request, latency_ms); aggregation=sample scatter with marginal histograms; allow regression line and selectable percentile subsets (top 5% tokens) for diagnostics
SLO Burn Rate sparkline: metric=slo_error_rate with burn-rate overlay; alert thresholds shown; tooltip includes upstream incident link when present
interaction_patterns: Model selector is global to the page and filters all charts + route list
Route quick actions: pin route, open route in Observability, start rollout to canary from the dashboard
Comparison mode: select up to two model versions or two time ranges; charts display delta overlays and a compact diff summary (p90 diff, tokens diff, cost diff)
Drilldown: clicking a chart segment opens route detail or raw-sample modal with copyable request payloads and link to related traces/PRs
Annotations: team members can add manual annotations for incidents or config changes; these render across time series charts
review_notes: PM (Ravi Kapoor): favor succinct defaults (24h) and emphasize comparison mode as primary rollout troubleshooting tool
Eng (Marco Nguyen): backend can provide 1m aggregates and raw samples for 6h windows; avoid requests for full raw sampling beyond 6h without toggle
SRE (Julian Gomez): require p99 and tail waterfall to support post-incident RCA; request addition of deploy annotations from CI system
Design (Claire Reed): prefer small-multiple layout for model-level vs route-level to reduce cognitive load; consider card-based responsive layout for narrow viewports
decisions: Default time window set to 24h to balance immediacy and signal; quick presets available
Provide 1m aggregated metrics for all charts; raw-sample waterfall limited to 6h by default with opt-in for longer windows
Comparison mode supports exactly two axes (version A vs B) to keep UI simple; additional comparisons via CSV export
Show cost per 1k tokens on model-level overview only; route-level cost uses proportional split derived from token counts
tradeoffs: Show more raw samples for deeper RCA vs UI performance and backend cost: chosen conservative default with opt-in for heavy sampling
Complexity of correlation charts vs discoverability: limit to scatter + marginal histograms and surface advanced diagnostics behind a toggle to avoid clutter
